1	-- init.lua — local-whisper: Hammerspoon-only dictation
2	-- Hold a modifier key → record → transcribe → insert at cursor
3	-- No Karabiner needed. Just Hammerspoon + ffmpeg + whisper.cpp
4	
5	require("hs.ipc")
6	
7	-- Required so the overlay canvas can appear above full-screen apps/spaces on any
8	-- display (e.g. a full-screen Remote Desktop session) — see hs.canvas:bringToFront notes.
9	hs.dockicon.hide()

11	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
12	-- Configuration
13	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
14	
15	local HOME = os.getenv("HOME")
16	local TMPDIR = os.getenv("TMPDIR") or "/tmp"
17	local WHISPER_TMP = TMPDIR .. "/whisper-dictate"
18	local CHUNK_DIR = WHISPER_TMP .. "/chunks"
19	
20	-- Config directory (all user settings live here)
21	local CONFIG_DIR = HOME .. "/.local-whisper"
22	os.execute("mkdir -p '" .. CONFIG_DIR .. "'")
23	
24	-- External binaries (absolute paths, with ARM/Intel fallback)
25	local FFMPEG = hs.fs.attributes("/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg") and "/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg" or "/usr/local/bin/ffmpeg"
26	local WHISPER_BIN = HOME .. "/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-cli"
27	local MODELS_DIR = HOME .. "/whisper.cpp/models"
28	local MODEL_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/model"
29	
30	-- Remote OpenAI-compatible transcription API (alternative to local whisper-cli)
31	local API = {
32	    MODEL_NAME = "API",  -- sentinel value stored in MODEL_FILE when API mode is selected
33	    URL = "http://192.168.0.13:13305/v1/audio/transcriptions",
34	    MODEL_ID = "Whisper-Large-v3",  -- must match the model id the server has loaded (GET /v1/models)
35	    CURL_BIN = "/usr/bin/curl",
36	}
37	
38	-- Scan available models
39	local function getAvailableModels()
40	    local models = {}
41	    local ok, iter, dir = pcall(hs.fs.dir, MODELS_DIR)
42	    if not ok then return models end
43	    for file in iter, dir do
44	        local name = file:match("^ggml%-(.+)%.bin$")
45	        if name then table.insert(models, name) end
46	    end
47	    table.sort(models)
48	    return models
49	end
50	
51	-- Get/set active model
52	local function getModelName()
53	    local saved = ""
54	    local f = io.open(MODEL_FILE, "r")
55	    if f then saved = f:read("*a"):gsub("%s+", ""); f:close() end
56	    if saved == API.MODEL_NAME then return API.MODEL_NAME end
57	    if saved ~= "" then
58	        -- Verify model file exists
59	        local path = MODELS_DIR .. "/ggml-" .. saved .. ".bin"
60	        local attr = hs.fs.attributes(path)
61	        if attr then return saved end
62	    end
63	    return "medium"  -- default
64	end
65	
66	local function isApiMode()
67	    return getModelName() == API.MODEL_NAME
68	end
69	
70	local function getModelPath()
71	    return MODELS_DIR .. "/ggml-" .. getModelName() .. ".bin"
72	end

74	-- Audio device: ":default" for system default, ":0", ":1" etc. for specific
75	-- Note: avfoundation requires colon prefix for audio-only (":0" not "0")
76	local AUDIO_DEVICE = ":default"
77	
78	-- Auto-fix missing colon prefix (common setup mistake)
79	if AUDIO_DEVICE ~= ":default" and not AUDIO_DEVICE:match("^:") then
80	    AUDIO_DEVICE = ":" .. AUDIO_DEVICE

83	-- Trigger key: "rightAlt", "rightCmd", "rightCtrl"
84	local TRIGGER_KEY = "rightCmd"
85	
86	-- User preference files (all in CONFIG_DIR)
87	local LANG_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/lang"
88	local OUTPUT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/output"
89	local PREFERRED_LANGS_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/preferred_langs"
90	local ENTER_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/enter"
91	local PROMPT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/prompt"
92	local RECENT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/recent.json"
93	local LOG_FILE = WHISPER_TMP .. "/whisper-dictate.log"
94	
95	-- Action hooks config
96	local ACTIONS_FILE = HOME .. "/.hammerspoon/local_whisper_actions.lua"
97	
98	-- Auto-stop on silence
99	local AUTO_STOP_SILENCE_SECONDS = 3
100	local AUTO_STOP_THRESHOLD_DB = -40

102	-- LLM refinement (requires Ollama)
103	local REFINE_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine"
104	local REFINE_PROMPT_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine_prompt"
105	local REFINE_MODEL_FILE = CONFIG_DIR .. "/refine_model"
106	local REFINE_DEFAULT_MODEL = "gemma3:4b"
107	local REFINE_MIN_CHARS = 50  -- skip refinement for short text
108	local REFINE_DEFAULT_PROMPT = "You are a text cleanup tool. Output ONLY the cleaned text, nothing else. Fix punctuation and capitalization. Remove ONLY filler words like um, uh, you know, I mean. Do NOT remove sentences or meaningful content. When the text lists sequential items using first/second/third or one/two/three, convert them into a numbered list with each item on a new line. NEVER add commentary or preamble. Just output the cleaned text."
109	
110	local function getRefineModel()
111	    local f = io.open(REFINE_MODEL_FILE, "r")
112	    if f then
113	        local val = f:read("*a"):gsub("%s+", ""); f:close()
114	        if val ~= "" then return val end
115	    end
116	    return REFINE_DEFAULT_MODEL
117	end
118	
119	local function getRefinePrompt()
120	    local f = io.open(REFINE_PROMPT_FILE, "r")
121	    if f then
122	        local content = f:read("*a"); f:close()
123	        content = content:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
124	        if content ~= "" then return content end
125	    end
126	    return REFINE_DEFAULT_PROMPT
127	end

129	local function hasOllama()
130	    -- Check if Ollama API is reachable
131	    local ok = os.execute("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '' http://localhost:11434/api/tags 2>/dev/null")
132	    if ok then return true end
133	    -- Fallback: check if binary exists
134	    return os.execute("command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1")
135	end
136	
137	local function getRefineMode()
138	    local f = io.open(REFINE_FILE, "r")
139	    if not f then return false end
140	    local val = f:read("*a"):gsub("%s+", ""); f:close()
141	    return val == "on"
142	end
143	
144	local function setRefineMode(on)
145	    local f = io.open(REFINE_FILE, "w")
146	    if f then f:write(on and "on" or "off"); f:close() end
147	end
148	
149	local function cycleRefine()
150	    local current = getRefineMode()
151	    setRefineMode(not current)
152	end

154	-- Timing
155	local PARTIAL_INTERVAL = 2.0   -- seconds between partial transcriptions
156	local OVERLAY_LINGER = 0.5     -- seconds to show final text before closing
157	
158	-- Known whisper hallucinations on silence/short audio
159	local HALLUCINATIONS = {
160	    "you", "thank you", "thanks for watching", "thanks for listening",
161	    "bye", "goodbye", "the end", "thank you for watching",
162	    "subscribe", "like and subscribe", "see you", "you.",
163	    "(applause)", "(keyboard clicking)", "(typing)", "(silence)",
164	    "(soft music)", "(lighter clicking)", "(applauding)",
165	    "[BLANK_AUDIO]", "[silence]",
166	}

174	    rightCmd  = hs.eventtap.event.rawFlagMasks["deviceRightCommand"],

187	
188	os.execute("mkdir -p '" .. WHISPER_TMP .. "'")

190	local function log(msg)
191	    local f = io.open(LOG_FILE, "a")
192	    if f then
193	        f:write(os.date("[%H:%M:%S] ") .. msg .. "\n")
194	        f:close()
195	    end
196	end

198	local function readFile(path)
199	    local f = io.open(path, "r")
200	    if not f then return "" end
201	    local content = f:read("*a") or ""
202	    f:close()
203	    return content
204	end
205	
206	local function writeFile(path, content)
207	    local f = io.open(path, "w")
208	    if not f then return end
209	    f:write(content)
210	    f:close()
211	end
212	
213	local function getLang()
214	    local lang = readFile(LANG_FILE):gsub("%s+", "")
215	    if lang == "en" or lang == "ru" or lang == "uk" or lang == "auto" then return lang end
216	    return "en"
217	end
218	
219	local function getOutputMode()
220	    local mode = readFile(OUTPUT_FILE):gsub("%s+", "")
221	    if mode == "type" then return "type" end
222	    if mode == "copy" then return "copy" end
223	    return "paste"
224	end
225	
226	local function getPreferredLangs()
227	    local content = readFile(PREFERRED_LANGS_FILE):gsub("%s+$", "")
228	    if content == "" then return {"en"} end
229	    local langs = {}
230	    for lang in content:gmatch("[^,]+") do
231	        lang = lang:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
232	        if lang ~= "" then table.insert(langs, lang) end
233	    end
234	    return #langs > 0 and langs or {"en"}
235	end

237	local function getEnterMode()
238	    local mode = readFile(ENTER_FILE):gsub("%s+", "")
239	    return mode == "on"
240	end

242	local function shellQuote(text)
243	    return "'" .. tostring(text):gsub("'", "'\\''") .. "'"
244	end

246	local function expandPath(path)
247	    if type(path) ~= "string" then return nil end
248	    if path:sub(1, 2) == "~/" then return HOME .. path:sub(2) end
249	    return path
250	end
251	
252	local function ensureParentDir(path)
253	    local parent = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
254	    if not parent or parent == "" then return true end
255	    local ok = os.execute("mkdir -p " .. shellQuote(parent))
256	    return ok == true or ok == 0
257	end

259	local function normalizeText(text)
260	    return ((text or ""):gsub("%s+", " ")):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
261	end

263	-- App bundle IDs where auto-capitalize should be skipped (terminals, code editors)
264	local NO_CAPITALIZE_APPS = {
265	    ["com.apple.Terminal"] = true,
266	    ["com.googlecode.iterm2"] = true,
267	    ["dev.warp.Warp-Stable"] = true,
268	    ["com.microsoft.VSCode"] = true,
269	    ["com.apple.dt.Xcode"] = true,
270	    ["com.jetbrains.intellij"] = true,
271	    ["com.sublimetext.4"] = true,
272	    ["com.github.atom"] = true,
273	    ["dev.zed.Zed"] = true,
274	}

276	-- Text post-processing: capitalize, remove fillers, clean whitespace
277	-- appBundleID is optional; when provided, adjusts behavior per-app
278	local function postProcess(text, appBundleID)
279	    -- Trim
280	    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
281	    if text == "" then return text end
282	    -- Remove filler words (standalone, case-insensitive)
283	    text = text:gsub("%f[%w][Uu][mm]%f[%W]", "")
284	    text = text:gsub("%f[%w][Uu][hh]%f[%W]", "")
285	    text = text:gsub("%f[%w][Hh][Mm][Mm]+%f[%W]", "")
286	    -- Remove "like," used as filler (comma-following)
287	    text = text:gsub("%f[%w][Ll]ike,%s*", "")
288	    -- Collapse multiple spaces
289	    text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
290	    -- Trim again after removals
291	    text = text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
292	    -- Auto-capitalize first letter (skip for terminals and code editors)
293	    if not (appBundleID and NO_CAPITALIZE_APPS[appBundleID]) then
294	        text = text:gsub("^%l", string.upper)
295	    end
296	    return text
297	end
298	
299	local function refineWithOllama(text, callback)
300	    if not getRefineMode() or not hasOllama() or #text < REFINE_MIN_CHARS then
301	        callback(text)
302	        return
303	    end
304	    log("refine: sending to Ollama API (" .. #text .. " chars)")
305	    local prompt = getRefinePrompt() .. "\n\n" .. text
306	    local model = getRefineModel()
307	    -- Use Ollama HTTP API (more reliable than CLI, avoids version mismatch issues)
308	    local jsonPayload = hs.json.encode({
309	        model = model,
310	        prompt = prompt,
311	        stream = false,
312	    })
313	    local tmpPayload = WHISPER_TMP .. "/refine_payload.json"
314	    local f = io.open(tmpPayload, "w")
315	    if f then f:write(jsonPayload); f:close() end
316	    local task = hs.task.new("/usr/bin/curl", function(code, stdout, stderr)
317	        if code == 0 and stdout and #stdout > 0 then
318	            local ok, result = pcall(hs.json.decode, stdout)
319	            if ok and result and result.response then
320	                local refined = result.response:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
321	                -- Strip common LLM preamble
322	                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere%s+is%s+the%s+cleaned%s+text:%s*\n?", "")
323	                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere'?s?%s+the%s+cleaned[%-]?%s*text:%s*\n?", "")
324	                refined = refined:gsub("^[Hh]ere%s+is%s+the%s+refined%s+text:%s*\n?", "")
325	                refined = refined:gsub("^[Ss]ure[,!]?%s*[Hh]?e?r?e?'?s?%s*t?h?e?%s*", "")
326	                refined = refined:gsub("^%s+", "")
327	                if refined ~= "" then
328	                    log("refine: success (" .. #refined .. " chars)")
329	                    callback(refined)
330	                    return
331	                end
332	            end
333	        end
334	        log("refine: failed (code=" .. tostring(code) .. "), using original")
335	        callback(text)
336	    end, {
337	        "-s", "-X", "POST",
338	        "http://localhost:11434/api/generate",
339	        "-H", "Content-Type: application/json",
340	        "-d", "@" .. tmpPayload,
341	    })
342	    task:setEnvironment({ HOME = HOME, PATH = "/usr/bin:/bin" })
343	    task:start()
344	end

346	local function isHallucination(text)
347	    local lower = text:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
348	    -- strip trailing period for comparison
349	    local stripped = lower:gsub("[%.%!%?]+$", "")
350	    for _, h in ipairs(HALLUCINATIONS) do
351	        if stripped == h:lower() or lower == h:lower() then return true end
352	    end
353	    -- Also filter anything in brackets/parens (whisper noise markers)
354	    if lower:match("^%[.*%]$") or lower:match("^%(.*%)$") then return true end
355	    return false
356	end

358	local function getChunkFiles()
359	    local chunks = {}
360	    local ok, iter, dir = pcall(hs.fs.dir, CHUNK_DIR)
361	    if not ok then return chunks end
362	    for file in iter, dir do
363	        if file:match("^chunk_.*%.wav$") then
364	            table.insert(chunks, CHUNK_DIR .. "/" .. file)
365	        end
366	    end
367	    table.sort(chunks)
368	    return chunks
369	end

371	-- Cycle helpers
372	local function cycleLang()
373	    local cycle = { en = "ru", ru = "uk", uk = "auto", auto = "en" }
374	    local next = cycle[getLang()] or "en"
375	    writeFile(LANG_FILE, next)
376	    return next
377	end
378	
379	local function cycleModel()
380	    local models = getAvailableModels()
381	    table.insert(models, API.MODEL_NAME)  -- remote API is the last stop in the cycle
382	    if #models == 0 then return getModelName() end
383	    local current = getModelName()
384	    local next = models[1]
385	    for i, m in ipairs(models) do
386	        if m == current and models[i + 1] then
387	            next = models[i + 1]
388	            break
389	        end
390	    end
391	    if next == current then next = models[1] end
392	    writeFile(MODEL_FILE, next)
393	    return next
394	end
395	
396	local function cycleOutput()
397	    local cur = getOutputMode()
398	    local next = (cur == "paste") and "type" or (cur == "type") and "copy" or "paste"
399	    writeFile(OUTPUT_FILE, next)
400	    return next
